subject: general
question:
**In the given sentence the underlined word may have been incorrectly spelt. Identify the option that rectifies the spelling. If there is no error in spelling, select ‘No error’.**

During my time - taking and gradual __convaelescenc__ after my back injury, my family was by my side.
solution:
The correct answer **"convalescence".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the incorrectly **spelt** word is **"convaelescenc"** which is not making any sense.
 
• The **correct word** will be **convalescence**.
 
• The process of **recovering your health and well-being** following an **illness or surgery** is known as **convalescence**. (आरोग्यलाभ)

 

**Correct sentence:**__ *During my time-taking and gradual **__convalescence__** after my back injury, my family was by my side.*
